_note: Brand registry. The 'Update brand catalogues' workflow checks each site and, reads the store's product catalogue (Shopify feed, WooCommerce feed, or the site's product sitemap and product pages) and saves product titles, prices, links and image links to data/brands/<id>.json. Images stay on the brand's own servers. Add a brand by adding a line here: id, name, site, focus (women, men, kids, home).
